description: No technical mechanism prevents a loop from repeating the known prior failure (a human-menu response instead of acting). The 'never ask a human' rule exists only as prose inside the STARTUP prompt string; the claude CLI is invoked without any non-interactive/print flag or post-hoc transcript check, so nothing stops a turn from ending on plain text (e.g. a menu of options) with no tool call. Because the tmux session is detached with nobody attached to answer, such a turn simply sits idle forever. The ONLY corrective mechanism is the heartbeat-staleness check, which needs up to 26 hours (STALE_MIN=1560 minutes) before it even notices, let alone fixes anything.

evidence.snippet: STARTUP='... ABSOLUTE RULE: you NEVER ask a human or stop for direction ...' ... tmux -S "$SOCK" new-session -d -s "$SESSION" "$CLAUDE" --name "$SESSION" --model sonnet --dangerously-skip-permissions --add-dir "$HOME" -- "$TASK"

concreteFailureScenario: The sonnet session reproduces the previously-observed behaviour: it ends its turn with a text menu ('Option A: ... Option B: ... which would you like?') instead of calling a tool. Nobody is attached to the detached tmux pane to answer. The heartbeat file (.reddit-loop-last-pass) is never touched because STEP4 never runs. reddit-loop-healthcheck.sh (STALE_MIN=1560, line 6) only flags this as STALE after 26 hours, during which the loop is fully autonomy-broken and nothing in the wiring detects or corrects it.
